        cq.Vector(cx - w / 2, cy - d / 2, z),
        cq.Vector(cx + w / 2, cy - d / 2, z),
        cq.Vector(cx + w / 2, cy + d / 2, z),
        cq.Vector(cx - w / 2, cy + d / 2, z),
        cq.Vector(cx - w / 2, cy - d / 2, z),
    ]
    return cq.Wire.makePolygon(pts)

L, W, H = 0.75, 0.51, 0.44   # length (X), width (Y), height (Z)
a = 0.25                     # size of the cut at the corner
d = 0.21                     # cylindrical hole diameter

# Tetrahedral cutter removing one corner (at +X, +Y, +Z)
P = cq.Vector(L, W, H)
A = cq.Vector(L - a, W, H)
B = cq.Vector(L, W - a, H)
C = cq.Vector(L, W, H - a)

def face(p1, p2, p3):
    wire = cq.Wire.makePolygon([p1, p2, p3], close=True)
    return cq.Face.makeFromWires(wire)

shell = cq.Shell.makeShell([
    face(P, A, B),
    face(P, B, C),
    face(P, C, A),
    face(A, B, C),
])
corner_cutter = cq.Solid.makeSolid(shell)

block = block.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").add(corner_cutter))

# Cylindrical hole through the full height
hole = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.3, 0.25)
    .circle(d / 2)
    .extrude(H)
)

result = block.cut(hole)
